4137.title: Question shortcut submission
4137.rootCauseOneLine: Number shortcuts update selection without moving focus, and the question form has no Enter handler for option answers.
4137.proposedFix: Focus the form after numbered option selection and handle plain Enter on the focused container through existing advance/submit logic.
4137.caveats: Component-level tests and Chromium harness; no full provider journey or Brave/Omarchy check. Click-option then Enter contrast was not reproduced on current main.
